remarks: UNDER CONS. Welcome to Klarvatten! This two-storey home offers 2,124 sq. ft. with four bedrooms upstairs, three full bathrooms and a main-floor den. The kitchen features a centre island and walk-in pantry and opens to a great room with a fireplace. Sliding doors connect the dining area to the rear deck. Just off the foyer, the den sits across from a full bathroom, making it a convenient space for a home office or overnight guests. Upstairs, a central bonus room provides a second living space, with laundry on the same level as all four bedrooms. The primary suite features a raised ceiling, walk-in closet and five-piece ensuite with dual sinks, a soaker tub and a separate shower. A mudroom with a built-in bench and cubbies connects to the double attached garage. A separate side entrance provides access to the basement stairs. (id:67522)
